title: माधवी उपन्यासकी माधवीको चारित्रिक विशेषता {A Characteristic Feature of Madhavi in the Novel Madhavi}
nepali: ‘माधवी’ (२०३९) उत्तरवैदिककालीन समाजको ऐतिहासिक पुनर्निर्माण गरी प्रस्तुत गरिएको उपन्यास हो । यस उपन्यासमा पात्रलाई ऐतिहासिक विकासक्रमको संवाहकका रूपमा चित्रित गरिएको छ र उत्तरवैदिक कालको युगीनसन्दर्भलाई सिङ्गो सग्लो रूपमा देखाउनका लागि यस उपन्यासमा माधवीलाई नायिकाको भूमिकामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । उत्तरवैदिक युगका तेह्रवटा जनपदको विकासको स्वरूप प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा माधवीकै सन्दर्भबाट प्रकटिएका छन् । अहिच्छत्रको एक राजकुमारी, एक महामाया गणिका, गालवको गुरुदक्षिणा पूर्तिका लागि केशशुल्का बन्न बाध्यभएकी र चार ओटा सम्राटकी पुत्रप्रसू माता र अन्ततः गालवकी जीवनसँगिनी बन्न पुगेकी माधवीका विभिन्न चारित्रिक विशेषताहरू देखापर्दछन् । ती विशेषताहरूलाई विभिन्न आधारमा यस लेखमा विवेचना गरिएको छ । चारित्रिक विशेषताको विश्लेषण उपन्यासको विधासिद्धान्त अन्तर्गत पात्रविश्लेषणको सिद्धान्तका आधारमा गरिएको छ । अध्ययन गुणात्मक पद्धतिमा गरिएको छ र वर्णनात्मक एवं विवेचनात्मक विधिमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । सिङ्गो उत्तरवैदिकयुगको प्रस्तुतिको माध्यम बनेकी माधवी यस उपन्यासकी माधवी महत्वपूर्ण पात्र हो भन्ने यस लेखको निष्कर्ष हो । {Madhavi (2039 B. S.) is a novel that presents a historical reconstruction of post-Vedic society. The protagonist in this novel is portrayed as an agency of historical developments. In this novel, Madhavi is presented in the role of a heroine to show the epochal context of the post-Vedic period in its entirety. The pattern of development of the thirteen countries of the post-Vedic period is directly or indirectly revealed in the context of Madhavi. Madhavi, a princess of Ahichchhatra, a Mahamaya courtesan, was forced to become a keshashulka (courtesan) to fulfill Galav's Gurudakshina and became the mother giving birth to four emperor sons and eventually became Galav's life partner. These features are discussed in this article on various grounds. The Characteristic analysis is done based on the character analysis principle under the theory of the novel genre. The study is conducted in a qualitative methodology and is analyzed in a descriptive and critical method. This article concludes that Madhavi is a significant character in this novel, which has become the medium of presentation of the entire post-Vedic era.}
american_english: 'Madhavi' (2039) is a novel presented through a historical reconstruction of post-Vedic society. In this novel, characters are portrayed as vehicles of historical development, and Madhavi is presented in the role of the heroine in order to depict the epochal context of the post-Vedic era in its entirety. The development patterns of the thirteen janapadas of the post-Vedic era are revealed directly or indirectly through the context of Madhavi herself. A princess of Ahichchhatra, a mahamaya courtesan, forced to become a keshashulka to fulfill Galava's gurudakshina, a son-bearing mother to four emperors, and ultimately becoming Galava's life companion, diverse character traits of Madhavi emerge. Those traits are discussed in this article on various grounds. The analysis of character traits is conducted on the basis of the theory of character analysis under the genre theory of the novel. The study is conducted using a qualitative methodology, and the analysis is performed through descriptive and critical methods. This article concludes that Madhavi, who served as the medium for presenting the entire post-Vedic era, is a significant character in this novel.
